Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded “24 laps” by assuming a 440-yard track and misapplying “short-start” logic without verification. A 10,000 m race is 25 laps on a standard 400 m track, and even on a 440-yard track the short-start is used to finish at the common line after 25 laps, not 24. The WebSurfer’s results did not confirm track length or lap count, yet the Planner declared TASK_COMPLETE with an unsupported and incorrect answer.
